texto.es: Reserva tu cita online o pasa directo: walk ins bienvenidos los 7 días de la semana.
texto.en: Book your appointment online or walk straight in: walk ins welcome 7 days a week.

texto.es: Conversamos tu idea, tamaño y ubicación para dejar el diseño listo antes de tatuar.
texto.en: We talk through your idea, size and placement to lock the design before we tattoo.

texto.es: Trabajamos en un espacio limpio y tranquilo, con el mismo cuidado que ves en nuestras reseñas.
texto.en: We work in a clean, calm space, with the same care you see in our reviews.

texto.es: Te explicamos el cuidado del tatuaje recién hecho y quedamos para cualquier retoque.
texto.en: We walk you through healing care for the fresh tattoo and are here for any touch up.

nota.es: Cada tatuaje se cotiza según diseño, tamaño y ubicación. Escríbenos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every tattoo is quoted based on design, size and placement. Message us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Retratos y piezas de realismo en blanco y negro o color, con sombreado y detalle fino.
texto.en: Black and grey or color realism pieces, portraits included, with fine shading and detail.

texto.es: Diseños de línea fina y lettering, ideales para piezas delicadas y primeros tatuajes.
texto.en: Fine line designs and lettering, great for delicate pieces and first tattoos.

texto.es: Piezas a color con contraste fuerte, de flores y ojos a diseños neo tradicionales.
texto.en: Bold color work, from florals and eye pieces to neo traditional designs.

texto.es: Rediseño y cobertura de tatuajes viejos para darles una segunda vida.
texto.en: Redesign and coverage of old tattoos to give them a second life.

pie.es: No ves exactamente lo que buscas? Escríbenos por Booksy y te confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you are looking for? Message us on Booksy and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: Limitless tattoo Miami is by far the best. My wife and I came to Miami from Michigan on a vacation and I wanted some art work touched up. I called, they had an opening, and I came for 3 days straight. Santiago is very talented.

Limitless Tattoo shop was amazing, everyone was super friendly and patient with us, me and my girls all got matching tats and they came out amazing. Definitely recommend this place to everyone, super clean and calm space.
Great atmosphere and great customer service. Santiago is a phenomenal tattoo artist and he did an amazing job on my daughter's tattoo. We would absolutely recommend him.
